fields.validation_summary: Review pushback: useful fixture coverage exists and `rtk cargo test -p ticket-api cross_worktree_move_from_submodule_to_root_is_clean_and_reversible -- --nocapture` passed, but AC is not fully met. Exact gaps: fixture uses independent git init worktrees rather than real git submodules/pinned submodule pointer mechanics; manifest gives submodule-a only `.ticket` and submodule-b only `.spec`, not >=2 store types per worktree; the E2E asserts clean verbatim paths/rollback but not manual-followup detection.

Validation passed: rtk cargo test -p ticket-api --test e2e_fixture_move cross_worktree_move_from_submodule_to_root_is_clean_and_reversible -- --nocapture; rtk cargo test -p memory-fixtures -- --nocapture.
